line: Hi friends! I am Rayo! Welcome to Sunny Park! Today we are going on a brand new adventure!
Hi friends! I am Rayo! Look at this flower meadow! Butterflies are dancing everywhere!
Hi friends! I am Rayo! Welcome to the big colorful city! So many tall buildings and happy people!

What a perfect day with my best friends! Remember kids, adventures are better together! Bye bye!
Racing with my best friends is the best fun ever! Remember kids, friends make every day special! Bye bye!

Rolling over the green hills! I am Bruno, the big truck! The open highway is my home!
Howdy little friends! I am Bruno, the big truck! I carry heavy loads and help everyone on the highway!
Big or small, friends are friends! What a wonderful journey together! Bye bye everyone!
